description: Set path attributes on paths (inside groups and compound paths too): even-odd or non-zero fill rule, closed or open, make or release guides, and align to pixel grid (Transform panel)

evenOdd.description: true: even-odd fill rule; false: non-zero winding

guide.description: true: make the paths guides (View > Guides > Make Guides); false: release them

pixelAligned.description: Align to Pixel Grid (applies to the targets themselves)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)
